resolution.note: OSC regex made linear; only OSC 0/2 with one title arg set title

title: Certain terminal title escape sequences make colorama hang or mishandle
body: Bug: writing an OSC (operating system command) sequence to a colorama-wrapped stream with conversion on misbehaves: '\x1b]' followed by 64 semicolons and a terminator that is not BEL makes the regex hang or crash; '\x1b]0\x07' with no title argument and '\x1b]1;title\x07' must not set the window title; only OSC 0 and OSC 2 with exactly one title argument may.

acceptance.verify: PYTHONPATH=. mise exec pipx:pytest@9.2.0 -- pytest -q colorama --deselect colorama/tests/initialise_test.py::InitTest::testInitDoesntWrapOnEmulatedWindows --deselect colorama/tests/initialise_test.py::InitTest::testInitDoesntWrapOnNonWindows
